prerequisites: Having passed at least 120 ECTS of the study plan for the degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Contribute to the comprehensive education of students, complementing their theoretical and practical teachings.
Facilitate knowledge of the appropriate work methodology for the professional reality in which students will operate as graduates, contrasting and applying the acquired knowledge.
Promote the development of students' decision-making capacity and critical thinking.

syllabus_topics: Particular conditions of each internship placement

assessment_methods.method: Monitoring assessment (Valoración del seguimiento del tutor de la empresa)
Monitoring assessment (Valoración del seguimiento del tutor académico)

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * Internship Report Grade + 0.5 * Monitoring Grade. A minimum of 4 points is required in both the Internship Report Grade and the Monitoring Grade to pass the subject. The final grade must be greater than or equal to 5 to pass. If the minimum is not met in either the Internship Report Grade or the Monitoring Grade, the maximum final grade will be 4 points. Extraordinary calls follow the same procedure as ordinary calls.
